<h2>Prepare an Ordered Fold Partition</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Filters a data frame to requested fold identifiers and restores the exact
deterministic identifier order. Missing-value handling remains caller-owned.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_ordered_fold_partition(
  data_partition_source = NULL,
  partition_ids = NULL,
  id_column = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_partition_source">data_partition_source</code></td>
<td>
<p>Data frame containing the complete sample universe.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="partition_ids">partition_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Unique ordered identifiers requested for one fold partition.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="id_column">id_column</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar naming the identifier column.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Filtered data frame in 'partition_ids' order with source columns unchanged.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_ordered_fold_partition(
  data_partition_source = tibble::tibble(
    sample_id = base::c("b", "a"),
    value = 1:2
  ),
  partition_ids = base::c("a", "b"),
  id_column = "sample_id"
)
</code></pre>
